applicability.rationale: Native pointer lifetime and ABI shape cannot be delegated implicitly.

delegated.bounds: May change inside api if public contracts and lifecycle ownership remain intact.
May change if race-free behavior, terminal Close semantics, and evidence remain equivalent.

fixed.rationale: Go pointer lifetime is a soundness boundary.
fixed.statement: Native code may not retain the Go pointer after the qualified call returns.

prohibited: Duplicating Service closed-state policy in cmd/app.
Returning an output channel without one explicit close owner.
Treating a passing race run as proof of goroutine termination.

acceptanceCriteria: Public API and error contracts are explicit.
Package and goroutine/channel ownership are unambiguous.
Cancellation and shutdown have direct evidence.
